name: Slater Park Summer Camp
description_short: A City of Pawtucket day camp at Slater Memorial Park for Pawtucket residents ages 6-13, weekdays 9am-2pm, in two 3-week sessions. Campers do sports, arts and crafts, games and nature walks, with lunch, pool trips and a camp T-shirt included and optional paid field trips.

The page says 'Registration opens this Friday, May 1st' (2026). This date was not recorded as a session because no sessions are listed.
The only address and phone on the page are for Pawtucket City Hall (137 Roosevelt Avenue, (401) 728-0500). These are the city's general contact details, not the camp's, so they were not recorded.
